title: The Unexploded Legacy
logline: An old piece of unexploded ordinance is found in a civilian sector, and two factions argue over whether to safely disarm it or weaponize it.

roles.description: Sees the ordinance as a deterrent, not a danger.
An abandoned colony habitat where the bomb rests.

public_situation: A massive, unexploded bomb from a forgotten war has been discovered lodged in a local habitat.
private_truth: The bomb is still fully functional, and the official wants to reverse-engineer it to threaten a neighboring system.

beats.public_change: The local government quarantines the habitat.

missions.reason: Needs a pilot to perform a close-range scan of the bomb's detonator casing.
missions.private_fact: The engineer suspects the official has already tampered with it.

missions.reason: Needs secure communication relays delivered to coordinate the evacuation.
missions.private_fact: The relays also contain a dead-man's switch tied to the engineer's vitals.

beats.public_change: The official announces a 'research initiative' regarding the bomb.

missions.reason: Needs specialized chemical neutralizers delivered from off-world.
missions.private_fact: The neutralizers are illegal to transport without a military license.

beats.public_change: The official intercepts the delivery and seizes the neutralizers.

missions.reason: The official hires the pilot to deliver a new triggering mechanism.
missions.private_fact: The official plans to arm the bomb immediately as a show of force.

beats.public_change: The standoff reaches a breaking point at the ordinance site.

missions.reason: Needs dense ferrite shielding delivered to contain the blast if the official arms it.
missions.private_fact: The engineer is going to manually defuse it while the pilot shields them.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot must choose who to support in the final confrontation.

options.label: Deliver the shielding to the engineer
Let the official weaponize the bomb
Abandon the bomb and let a third party take it

resolutions.summary: The bomb is safely neutralized. The habitat is saved, but the government loses its leverage.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot supports the official or abandons the missions.
resolutions.summary: The bomb is armed. The neighboring system yields to the threat, plunging the region into a cold war.
A third party steals the bomb during the chaos. The official and the engineer both face the fallout.

loose_threads.detail: The bomb's serial number indicates it was manufactured by a peaceful agricultural commune.
The official mentions an 'anonymous benefactor' who tipped them off to the bomb's location.

radio_hooks: Evacuations ordered in civilian sector following discovery of unexploded ordinance.
Local government assures public that the bomb is 'under control'.

voice_direction.cautious_engineer: Nervous, exact, speaks in measured tones.
